evidence: Frozen task/task.toml (sha256 ac664d0e...9f26, matches manifest) [environment] block: build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096 (task.toml:[environment]). `diff` against the frozen template task.toml shows differences ONLY in [task] name/description/keywords and [metadata] difficulty/difficulty_explanation/category/provenance/arena_slice; [agent], [environment], [verifier], [verifier.env], [verifier.environment] are byte-identical to the template and to the staged-task-contract block. No docker_image, allow_internet, gpu_types or --platform anywhere in task.toml or environment/Dockerfile (grep empty), satisfying quality-checks.md #9 'docker_image absent; allow_internet omitted' and common checks check-allow-internet.sh / check-no-allow-internet-true.sh / check-dockerfile-platform.sh. 2 CPUs / 4096 MB is sane for the workload: the agent image (environment/Dockerfile, sha256 0a75419e...67d1, byte-identical to the template Dockerfile) is node:22-bookworm-slim with globally preinstalled express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 and no compile/bundle step; the golden app (solution/app/package.json, server.js, src/*.js, public/*) is a plain Express+SQLite app with no build tooling. Secret literals: the only env values with credentials are in [verifier.env], where ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" is a template and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "" is empty - no literal. Agent-image inputs (environment/Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md) grepped for sk-/api_key/secret/token/password/PEM/AKIA/ghp_/xox/Bearer: only hit is hireops_rules.md:11 demo sign-in password `Hireops!2026`, also stated in instruction.md:19, which the workbook/skill profile explicitly allows (documented demo credential). seed_data.json keys contain no password/hash/token field and no >=32-char opaque strings; emails use reserved .example domains. Dockerfile ENV sets only NODE_PATH; git identity uses turing@local.invalid. network_mode = "public" not flagged per workbook row text and skill Delivery profile. Colderwater lessons checked for patterns bearing on this row: lesson 13 (public internet addresses in judge prompts) concerns row 25 judge prompts, not the agent environment posture, and does not change the public network_mode verdict here; lesson 11 (judge infra crashes) and lessons 1-10/12/14-21 concern brief, criteria, judge prompts and process, not agent CPU/memory/secret/network posture - no instance applies to row 9. Counterexample search: a broken app cannot pass or fail via this row (it is config-only); a conforming alternative could fail only if 2 CPU/4 GB were insufficient for a builder's chosen stack - with Express/better-sqlite3 preinstalled and public network for any extra npm install, a reasonable alternative (e.g. a small bundler build) fits within 4 GB; no plausible conforming app is starved. No runtime measurement is required for this static row; the raw-evidence-index golden run used the verifier image, not the agent image, so agent-image build under these limits is not measured but is the unchanged template configuration.
